documentationFormat.notes: Phase-3 Lean Contract Format (Session 3, 2026-05-16): All classes use 4-tag format only. Removed tags: @module-type, @domain-concept, @stability, @depends (use knowledge-graph.xml for dependencies instead).

tags: @purpose (one sentence, concrete verb describing class semantics)
@invariant (business rule or state constraint — one per tag, testable)
@purpose (mention BLOCK_ marker if architectural navigation needed)
handlers.note: BLOCK_ markers live in production code logs. Mention in @purpose for navigation only (never duplicate).

method.note: Only use @log-event and @trace-span if actually instrumenting the method

field_property.note: Property names are self-explanatory; use inline comments only for non-obvious meanings. Do NOT use @property tags.

migrationState.notes: Phase-3 cleanup: Updated module IDs to match knowledge-graph.xml (M-SHARED, M-READER, M-WRITER, M-CACHE, M-KEYCLOAK). Updated documentationFormat to Phase-3 lean 4-tag format. Removed deprecated tags. Code regeneration needed via batch processor.
